# AI OS documentation

Two kinds of document live here, and mixing them up is how the codebase drifted.

**Reference — describes the code as it is.** Generated by reading the source on
2026-08-15 and expected to be kept true. Start here.

| Document | What it covers |
|---|---|
| [architecture/KERNEL.md](architecture/KERNEL.md) | The request lifecycle end to end, the executor loop and its constants, trust decision points, planning vs direct execution, the scheduler and autonomy jobs, context management |
| [architecture/MEMORY.md](architecture/MEMORY.md) | The seven memory types, the write and read paths, provenance and taint, supersession and contradiction detection, the knowledge graph, and the full 26-migration table catalog |
| [architecture/TOOLS-AND-PACKS.md](architecture/TOOLS-AND-PACKS.md) | The complete tool catalog with trust classes, the `ToolDef`/`ToolContext` contract, the capability-pack system, Pack Forge, and the sandbox |
| [architecture/OPERATIONS.md](architecture/OPERATIONS.md) | The process model and ports, the complete HTTP API reference, the interfaces, the ops runbook, every environment variable, and the model router |
| [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) | The security model as built — threat model, trust gate, §8.3, SSRF, auth surfaces, **and an honest residuals list** |
| [ROADMAP.md](ROADMAP.md) | Where the project actually is (measured) and the phased plan, with exit criteria |

**Design — records intent and decisions at a point in time.** Historically
valuable, *not* ground truth.

| Document | Note |
|---|---|
| [BLUEPRINT.md](BLUEPRINT.md) | The original architecture. **Predates the code and has drifted** — see `SECURITY.md` §7 for the specific contradictions, three of which are §8.3 rules |
| [VISION.md](VISION.md), [PRINCIPLES.md](PRINCIPLES.md), [DOMAINS.md](DOMAINS.md) | Product intent and the domain map |
| [adr/](adr/) | 22 decision records. Several describe superseded behaviour; ADR-0021's "top next step" shipped weeks ago |
| [EVAL-SPEC.md](EVAL-SPEC.md), [FAILURE-CORPUS.md](FAILURE-CORPUS.md) | Evaluation design and the catalogued failure modes |

## The rule

When a design document and the code disagree, **the code wins and the document
is wrong**. The 2026-08-15 pass found 39 such disagreements. Stale security
documentation is actively harmful: it describes protection that is not there.

If you change behaviour that one of these reference documents describes, update
it in the same commit.
